kinds.doc: A not-yet-initialized binding (XS's `XS_UNINITIALIZED_KIND`, the "kind < 0" sentinel a `let`/`const`/`this` binding carries before its initializer runs; reading it is a TDZ…
kinds.name: Uninitialized

kinds.doc: A closure scope slot (XS's `XS_CLOSURE_KIND`): a scope cell that indirects to a shared heap cell rather than holding the value inline.
kinds.name: Closure

kinds.doc: An environment/reference sentinel produced by `EVAL_REFERENCE` and friends and consumed by `GET_VARIABLE`/`SET_VARIABLE`.
kinds.name: EnvReference

kinds.doc: A computed property key produced by `XS_CODE_AT`/`AT_2` (XS's `XS_AT_KIND`) and consumed by `GET_PROPERTY_AT`/`SET_PROPERTY_AT`/ `NEW_PROPERTY_AT`/`DELETE_PROPERTY_AT`.
kinds.name: At

payloads.doc: A BigInt (`Kind::BigInt`): the chunk holding `[sign: u8][LE u32 digits]`.
payloads.name: BigInt

tables.name: chunk_exts
tables.note: One row for each chunk extent. The row holds the arena bytes.

tables.name: edge_pairs
tables.note: Normalized page-edge pairs (the query-driven GC layer, store seam phase 10): one row per (target, page) edge, DERIVED from page_edges — never sealed, rebuildable — maintained in the same commit…

tables.name: free_segs
tables.note: Free-list segments (store seam phase 9): big-endian u32 entries; kind-2 rows in leaf_hashes checksum them.

tables.name: leaf_hashes
tables.note: Row-leaf hashes (store seam phase 5): kind 0 = slot page, 1 = chunk extent; 32-byte SHA-256 per row, maintained transactionally with the rows themselves.

tables.name: meta
tables.note: The manifest and the store stamps, as key and value.

tables.name: page_edges
tables.note: Page-edge summaries (store seam phase 6): the sorted outgoing page targets per slot page, as big-endian u32s.

tables.name: side_tables
tables.note: One row set per side-table ledger row, populated as the Pending atoms land paired with their store rows (design § Side tables: the ledger governs the schema).

tables.name: slot_pages
tables.note: One row for each slot page. The row holds the encoded slot records.

columns: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id >= 0 AND id < 32)
tables.name: small_sections
tables.note: One row for each small-state section, with the section hash.

tables.name: small_state
tables.note: The framed small state, for a store that predates the section split.
